import os
import datetime
import json
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, make_response
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from flask_migrate import Migrate
from flask_jwt_extended import (
    JWTManager, create_access_token,
    jwt_required, get_jwt_identity
)
from flask_cors import CORS
import smtplib
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from apscheduler.schedulers.background import BackgroundScheduler
from apscheduler.triggers.interval import IntervalTrigger
import threading

# Initialize Flask application
app = Flask(__name__)
app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = os.getenv('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///teamsyncpro.db')
app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS'] = False
app.config['JWT_SECRET_KEY'] = os.getenv('JWT_SECRET_KEY', 'super-secret-key')  # In production, use a secure key
app.config['JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRES'] = datetime.timedelta(days=1)

# Initialize extensions
db = SQLAlchemy(app)
migrate = Migrate(app, db)
jwt = JWTManager(app)
cors = CORS(app, resources={r"/*": {"origins": "*"}})

# Scheduler for automated tasks (e.g., report generation, reminders)
scheduler = BackgroundScheduler()
scheduler.start()

# Define database models
class User(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    username = db.Column(db.String(80), unique=True, nullable=False)
    email = db.Column(db.String(120), unique=True, nullable=False)
    password = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False)
    role = db.Column(db.String(20), default='User')  # e.g., 'Admin', 'Manager', 'User'
    tasks = db.relationship('Task', backref='assignee', lazy=True)
    projects = db.relationship('Project', backref='manager', lazy=True)

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            'id': self.id,
            'username': self.username,
            'email': self.email,
            'role': self.role,
        }

class Project(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False)
    description = db.Column(db.Text)
    start_date = db.Column(db.Date, default=db.func.current_date())
    end_date = db.Column(db.Date)
    manager_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('user.id'), nullable=False)
    tasks = db.relationship('Task', backref='project', lazy=True)

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            'id': self.id,
            'name': self.name,
            'description': self.description,
            'start_date': self.start_date.isoformat() if self.start_date else None,
            'end_date': self.end_date.isoformat() if self.end_date else None,
            'manager_id': self.manager_id,
        }

class Task(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False)
    description = db.Column(db.Text)
    start_date = db.Column(db.Date)
    due_date = db.Column(db.Date)
    status = db.Column(db.String(20), default='Pending')  # Pending, In Progress, Completed
    priority = db.Column(db.String(20), default='Normal')  # Low, Normal, High, Urgent
    project_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('project.id'), nullable=False)
    assignee_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('user.id'), nullable=True)
    comments = db.relationship('Comment', backref='task', lazy=True)

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            'id': self.id,
            'title': self.title,
            'description': self.description,
            'start_date': self.start_date.isoformat() if self.start_date else None,
            'due_date': self.due_date.isoformat() if self.due_date else None,
            'status': self.status,
            'priority': self.priority,
            'project_id': self.project_id,
            'assignee_id': self.assignee_id,
        }

class Comment(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    content = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=db.func.current_timestamp())
    task_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('task.id'), nullable=False)
    user_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('user.id'), nullable=False)
    user = db.relationship('User', backref='comments', lazy=True)

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            'id': self.id,
            'content': self.content,
            'created_at': self.created_at.isoformat(),
            'user': self.user.to_dict() if self.user else None,
        }

class Report(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    report_type = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)  # e.g., 'Project Progress', 'Resource Utilization'
    content = db.Column(db.JSON, nullable=False)
    generated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=db.func.current_timestamp())

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            'id': self.id,
            'report_type': self.report_type,
            'content': self.content,
            'generated_at': self.generated_at.isoformat(),
        }

# Helper functions
def send_email(receiver_email, subject, body):
    """Function to send email notifications"""
    sender_email = os.getenv('EMAIL_SENDER')
    sender_password = os.getenv('EMAIL_PASSWORD')
    
    message = MIMEMultipart()
    message['From'] = sender_email
    message['To'] = receiver_email
    message['Subject'] = subject
    message.attach(MIMEText(body, 'plain'))
    
    try:
        server = smtplib.SMTP('smtp.gmail.com', 587)
        server.starttls()
        server.login(sender_email, sender_password)
        text = message.as_string()

# CulturalConnect.py
# This file contains the backend implementation of the CulturalConnect web application using Python (Flask),
# MongoDB for the database, and Socket.IO for real-time chat.

from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, render_template, session
from flask_pymongo import PyMongo
from flask_bcrypt import Bcrypt
from flask_socketio import SocketIO, emit
import json
from bson.objectid import ObjectId
from datetime import datetime

app = Flask(__name__)
bcrypt = Bcrypt(app)
socketio = SocketIO(app, cors_allowed_origins="*")

# MongoDB Configuration
app.config["MONGO_URI"] = "mongodb://localhost:27017/cultural_connect"
mongo = PyMongo(app)

# User Authentication API Endpoints
@app.route("/register", methods=["POST"])
def register():
    """
    Register a new user by storing their data in MongoDB.
    """
    data = request.json
    username = data.get("username")
    email = data.get("email")
    password = data.get("password")

    # Check if username or email already exists
    if mongo.db.users.find_one({"username": username}) or mongo.db.users.find_one({"email": email}):
        return jsonify({"message": "Username or email already exists"}), 400

    # Hash the password
    hashed_password = bcrypt.generate_password_hash(password).decode("utf-8")

    # Insert new user into the database
    user_id = mongo.db.users.insert_one({
        "username": username,
        "email": email,
        "password": hashed_password,
        "created_at": datetime.utcnow()
    }).inserted_id

    return jsonify({"message": "User registered successfully", "user_id": str(user_id)}), 201


@app.route("/login", methods=["POST"])
def login():
    """
    Authenticate a user and set a session.
    """
    data = request.json
    username = data.get("username")
    password = data.get("password")

    user = mongo.db.users.find_one({"username": username})

    if not user or not bcrypt.check_password_hash(user["password"], password):
        return jsonify({"message": "Invalid credentials"}), 401

    # Set a session for the user
    session["user_id"] = str(user["_id"])

    return jsonify({"message": "Login successful", "user_id": str(user["_id"])}), 200


@app.route("/logout", methods=["POST"])
def logout():
    """
    Clear the user session.
    """
    session.clear()
    return jsonify({"message": "Logout successful"}), 200


# Content Management API Endpoints
@app.route("/content", methods=["POST"])
def add_content():
    """
    Add cultural content (e.g., literature, music, visual arts) to the database.
    """
    data = request.json
    user_id = session.get("user_id")

    if not user_id:
        return jsonify({"message": "Authentication required"}), 401

    content = {
        "user_id": ObjectId(user_id),
        "title": data.get("title"),
        "type": data.get("type"),
        "description": data.get("description"),
        "url": data.get("url", ""),
        "tags": data.get("tags", []),
        "created_at": datetime.utcnow()
    }

    content_id = mongo.db.content.insert_one(content).inserted_id
    return jsonify({"message": "Content added successfully", "content_id": str(content_id)}), 201


@app.route("/content", methods=["GET"])
def get_content():
    """
    Retrieve cultural content from the database.
    """
    content_list = list(mongo.db.content.find())
    for item in content_list:
        item["_id"] = str(item["_id"])
        item["user_id"] = str(item["user_id"])
    return jsonify(content_list), 200


@app.route("/content/<content_id>", methods=["GET"])
def get_content_by_id(content_id):
    """
    Retrieve specific cultural content by ID.
    """
    content = mongo.db.content.find_one({"_id": ObjectId(content_id)})
    if not content:
        return jsonify({"message": "Content not found"}), 404

    content["_id"] = str(content["_id"])
    content["user_id"] = str(content["user_id"])
    return jsonify(content), 200


# Recommendation System
@app.route("/recommendations", methods=["GET"])
def get_recommendations():
    """
    Provide content recommendations based on user preferences and interactions.
    """
    user_id = session.get("user_id")
    if not user_id:
        return jsonify({"message": "Authentication required"}), 401

    # Example: Find content similar to what the user has interacted with
    user_content = list(mongo.db.content.find({"user_id": ObjectId(user_id)}).limit(3))
    recommended_content = list(mongo.db.content.find({"tags": {"$in": [tag for item in user_content for tag in item.get("tags", [])]}}).limit(5))

    for item in recommended_content:
        item["_id"] = str(item["_id"])
        item["user_id"] = str(item["user_id"])

    return jsonify(recommended_content), 200


# Chat Feature with WebSockets
@socketio.on("send_message")
def handle_send_message(data):
    """
    Handle sending a message in the chat room.
    """
    emit("receive_message", data, broadcast=True)


@app.route("/")
def index():
    """
    Serve the main HTML file for the React frontend.
    This is a placeholder for the actual React frontend implementation.
    """
    return render_template("index.html")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    socketio.run(app, debug=True)

# CulturalConnect.py
# This file contains the backend implementation of the CulturalConnect web application using Python (Flask),
# MongoDB for the database, and Socket.IO for real-time chat.

from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, render_template, session
from flask_pymongo import PyMongo
from flask_bcrypt import Bcrypt
from flask_socketio import SocketIO, emit
import json
from bson.objectid import ObjectId
from datetime import datetime

app = Flask(__name__)
bcrypt = Bcrypt(app)
socketio = SocketIO(app, cors_allowed_origins="*")

# MongoDB Configuration
app.config["MONGO_URI"] = "mongodb://localhost:27017/cultural_connect"
mongo = PyMongo(app)

# User Authentication API Endpoints
@app.route("/register", methods=["POST"])
def register():
    """
    Register a new user by storing their data in MongoDB.
    """
    data = request.json
    username = data.get("username")
    email = data.get("email")
    password = data.get("password")

    # Check if username or email already exists
    if mongo.db.users.find_one({"username": username}) or mongo.db.users.find_one({"email": email}):
        return jsonify({"message": "Username or email already exists"}), 400

    # Hash the password
    hashed_password = bcrypt.generate_password_hash(password).decode("utf-8")

    # Insert new user into the database
    user_id = mongo.db.users.insert_one({
        "username": username,
        "email": email,
        "password": hashed_password,
        "created_at": datetime.utcnow()
    }).inserted_id

    return jsonify({"message": "User registered successfully", "user_id": str(user_id)}), 201


@app.route("/login", methods=["POST"])
def login():
    """
    Authenticate a user and set a session.
    """
    data = request.json
    username = data.get("username")
    password = data.get("password")

    user = mongo.db.users.find_one({"username": username})

    if not user or not bcrypt.check_password_hash(user["password"], password):
        return jsonify({"message": "Invalid credentials"}), 401

    # Set a session for the user
    session["user_id"] = str(user["_id"])

    return jsonify({"message": "Login successful", "user_id": str(user["_id"])}), 200


@app.route("/logout", methods=["POST"])
def logout():
    """
    Clear the user session.
    """
    session.clear()
    return jsonify({"message": "Logout successful"}), 200


# Content Management API Endpoints
@app.route("/content", methods=["POST"])
def add_content():
    """
    Add cultural content (e.g., literature, music, visual arts) to the database.
    """
    data = request.json
    user_id = session.get("user_id")

    if not user_id:
        return jsonify({"message": "Authentication required"}), 401

    content = {
        "user_id": ObjectId(user_id),
        "title": data.get("title"),
        "type": data.get("type"),
        "description": data.get("description"),
        "url": data.get("url", ""),
        "tags": data.get("tags", []),
        "created_at": datetime.utcnow()
    }

    content_id = mongo.db.content.insert_one(content).inserted_id
    return jsonify({"message": "Content added successfully", "content_id": str(content_id)}), 201


@app.route("/content", methods=["GET"])
def get_content():
    """
    Retrieve cultural content from the database.
    """
    content_list = list(mongo.db.content.find())
    for item in content_list:
        item["_id"] = str(item["_id"])
        item["user_id"] = str(item["user_id"])
    return jsonify(content_list), 200


@app.route("/content/<content_id>", methods=["GET"])
def get_content_by_id(content_id):
    """
    Retrieve specific cultural content by ID.
    """
    content = mongo.db.content.find_one({"_id": ObjectId(content_id)})
    if not content:
        return jsonify({"message": "Content not found"}), 404

    content["_id"] = str(content["_id"])
    content["user_id"] = str(content["user_id"])
    return jsonify(content), 200


# Recommendation System
@app.route("/recommendations", methods=["GET"])
def get_recommendations():
    """
    Provide content recommendations based on user preferences and interactions.
    """
    user_id = session.get("user_id")
    if not user_id:
        return jsonify({"message": "Authentication required"}), 401

    # Example: Find content similar to what the user has interacted with    user_id = ObjectId(user_id)
    # Retrieve user's interaction history (e.g., likes, views, shares)
    user_interactions = list(mongo.db.interactions.find({"user_id": user_id}))

    # Build a preference vector based on interactions
    content_tags = set()
    for interaction in user_interactions:
        content = mongo.db.content.find_one({"_id": interaction["content_id"]})
        if content:
            content_tags.update(content.get("tags", []))

    # Generate recommendations based on the user's interaction history and shared interests
    recommended_content = list(mongo.db.content.find({"tags": {"$in": list(content_tags)}}).sort("created_at", -1).limit(5))
    # Optionally enhance with collaborative filtering or embeddings
    for item in recommended_content:
        item["_id"] = str(item["_id"])
        item["user_id"] = str(item["user_id"])

    return jsonify(recommended_content), 200


# Chat Feature with WebSockets
@socketio.on("send_message")
def handle_send_message(data):
    """
    Handle sending a message in the chat room.
    """
    emit("receive_message", data, broadcast=True)


@app.route("/")
def index():
    """
    Serve the main HTML file for the React frontend.
    This is a placeholder for the actual React frontend implementation.
    """
    return render_template("index.html")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    socketio.run(app, debug=True)
